description: Per system face, the ledger evidence that proves the face FIRED in a real run. A fingerprint that cannot pass on a live workspace means the face is decorative. Consumed by devkit/liveness_gate.py; the product-side zero-activity auditor derives from the same spec (devkit/docs/liveness_fingerprints.md). Issue 805 extends the file to the HOOK battery: every hooks/battery.yaml face joins a fingerprint here (the registry x fingerprint join must be total); the dispatch checks read the worker_battery pass row the battery lands on every full pass.

fingerprints.face: the sampled family reaches the dispatch decision (#691, wiring: #773 W2 — the family-gate reject carries the draw; the retry's usage row records sampled_family+propensity in runs/method-family-log.jsonl)
a plan() admission receipt was consumed at dispatch (#760, wiring: #773 W3 — ledger plan-receipt/1)

the round close projected the policy-state surface — runs/policy-state.json, schema policy-state/1 (#769, producer: scripts/policy_state.run_face via hooks/round_closure; consumer: statusline_snapshot policy face)

posterior store rows update after settle — keyed by ARM (#807: case-level movement — key-less rows, dispatch-pending structural mass, or credits with no arm attribution — no longer satisfies the sentinel; INV-003 is a FAMILY-level live signal)
armed oracle cases exist — the reward source (#678 T5, wiring: #773 W1)
settlement credit flows at claim terminal

production settlements carry settler-identity rows from the BLIND path (#802, wiring: rlvr.settlement_wire.settle_parked via hooks/round_closure blind face; producer: the parked blind-settlement-input/1 ruling consumed through scalar.validate_verdict_doc)
